SK hynix Platinum P51 Internal SSD 1TB 2TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe Gen5 / Express

Features

- Next-Generation PCIe 5.0 Interface: Expands bandwidth up to two times compared to the previous PCIe 4.0 generation, delivering elite data transfer rates for demanding high-end computing environments.

- Blazing-Fast Sequential Performance: Achieves staggering sequential read speeds up to 14,700 MB/s and write speeds up to 13,400 MB/s, boasting a 100% performance improvement over standard PCIe 4.0 drives.

- Advanced 238-Layer 3D TLC NAND: Built with SK hynix's industry-leading 238-layer 3D TLC NAND flash architecture and an in-house Alistar/Cepheus controller for premium speed and efficiency.

- Dedicated LPDDR4 DRAM Cache: Equipped with an onboard SK hynix LPDDR4 DRAM cache alongside intelligent SLC caching to maintain peak performance during heavy, sustained workloads.

- Elite Durability and Reliability: Guarantees long-term stability with an expansive endurance rating up to 1,200 TBW and a MTBF rating of 2 million hours.

- Robust Hardware Encryption: Protects sensitive information through robust AES 256-bit hardware encryption, TCG Opal, and IEEE1667 encrypted drive standards.

Specifications

- Brand: SK hynix

- Product Name: Platinum P51 SSD

- Form Factor / Interface: M.2 2280 / PCIe 5.0 x4 NVMe

- Storage Capacities: 2TB, 1TB, 500GB

- NAND Flash Technology: SK hynix 238L 3D TLC

- Controller / DRAM: SK hynix Alistar (Cepheus) / SK hynix LPDDR4

- Sequential Performance (2TB/1TB): Read: 14,700 MB/s | Write: 13,400 MB/s

- Random Performance (2TB/1TB): Read: 2,300K IOPS | Write: 2,400K IOPS

- Response Time: Read: 33us | Write: 10us

- Endurance (TBW): Up to 1,200 TBW (2TB) / 600 TBW (1TB)

- Reliability (MTBF): 2,000,000 Hours

- Advanced Features: TRIM, Garbage Collection, S.M.A.R.T., DEVSLP, Temperature Sensor

- Operating Temperature: 0°C to 70°C

- Allowable Power: 3.3V ±5%

- Dimensions: 22.00 x 80.00 x 2.38 mm

- Weight: 7.0g ±5%

- Certifications: KC (R-R-HNX-PB801M280S), BSMI, CE, CU, UKCA, FCC, VCCI, TuV SUD, UL

- Country of Origin: South Korea
